title: Prepare for a service assessment
summary: Many public services are assessed against a service standard before moving phase. Prepare by doing the work well and showing it honestly.

beginner: Check whether your service needs an assessment and which standard applies.
Read the standard points and note your evidence for each.
Book early with your assurance team.
Prepare a short demo of the user journey, including what happens when things go wrong.
Bring the team members who can answer questions.
intermediate: Map evidence against each standard point.
Book and prepare the demo and team.
experienced: Build standard evidence into normal work.
Use the panel as peer review.

toolExamples.confluence: Keep an evidence page per standard point.

sources.title: What happens at a service assessment (GOV.UK Service Manual)
